title: Constant speed magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 5 m/s.

title: Deceleration time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 5 s.

title: Observation deck height
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be 437.5 m.

title: Apply Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution must correctly use apparent weight changes to calculate accelerations via F_net = m*a.

title: Velocity-time graph reasoning
description: Important: The total height must be found by calculating the area under a correctly constructed v-t graph or equivalent kinematics.

title: Correct mass and forces
description: Important: Calculations must use the student's actual mass (50 kg) and the correct net force from scale readings (e.g., 25 N upward during startup).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if accelerations or net forces have incorrect signs (e.g., treating deceleration magnitude as positive without justification).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All intermediate and final answers should have correct units (m/s, s, m, N, m/s²).
